routes.mount: Lazy Explore import inside SafeRoute; source registration confirmed, browser reachability unverified.

purpose: Feature-discovery hub derived from the existing shell navigation catalog, with descriptions, URL-driven search/category filtering and visibility-safe route suggestions.
primaryGoal: Find and open an eligible TeslaSync destination without losing search, category, navigation, authentication or fleet-visibility behavior.

dataSources.name: Feature catalog
dataSources.behavior: Flatten navSections in source order; enrich descriptions; carry minVehicles/requiresAuth; search English and translated labels/sections plus English descriptions and paths; exact category-name search overrides token splitting; otherwise case-insensitive AND-token matching. Grouping preserves shell section order.
dataSources.counts: Bounded static scan of Layout.tsx lines 183-522 found 22 title declarations and 199 to declarations. These are source declaration counts, not mounted/eligible destination counts.

dataSources.name: Fleet eligibility and vehicle counter
dataSources.behavior: Query key ['vehicles']; request forwards AbortSignal; FAST staleTime; safeArray selection. Returned list length gates destinations, not selected workspace vehicle or historical fleet total. Missing list uses zero only for conservative eligibility; metric rawValue stays undefined. Client prefixes /api/v1. Router registration is source evidence only; response completeness, permissions and pagination are unverified.

dataSources.name: Authentication-mode eligibility
dataSources.behavior: Query key ['auth','mode']; five-minute staleTime; signal forwarded; no interval or focus refetch. Boolean true only for resolved forward_auth; missing/failed contract is false. Page does not expose underlying auth query trust state. No inference that this is authorization enforcement.

dataSources.name: URL filters
dataSources.behavior: q and section round-trip through URL. Individual updates retain other parameters and replace history. Empty-result clear and suggestion pick intentionally clear all search parameters. No workspace date window.

dataSources.name: Closest-route suggestions
dataSources.behavior: Merge registry and catalog-label candidates, intersect with eligible catalog paths, de-duplicate by path, sort distance and retain at most five; hidden registry records excluded by engine. Source algorithm is inspected, not executed.

dataSources.name: Trust and display formatting
dataSources.behavior: Existing trust adapter retains fleet payload on refresh failure/pause. Four dimensionless raw counts use existing formatter bridge and preferences; no unit conversion or measurement fabrication. Formatting bridge imports useUnits/useFormatting; their deeper queries are outside this bounded inspection, not asserted as absent.

components.name: PageLayout
components.contract: PageContainer props forwarded; full-width min-w-0 container; shell owns header/navigation/workspace.

components.name: OperationalBrief
components.contract: compact, metrics, statusLabel/statusTone, scope, freshness, provenance, attention; existing Review details drawer retains metric evidence, narrative and attention.

components.name: PillFilterBar
components.contract: items key/label/count; activeKey/onChange; semanticMode=filters; scrollable=false; labelled pressed-button group and normal tab order.

components.name: Button
components.contract: Existing semantic variants, focus-ring tokens, wrapLabel, refs and native events; sm min-height 36px.

components.name: Input, GlassPanel, Badge, SectionTitle, Text, Caption
components.contract: Existing category imports; explicit explore-search identity/ref/name; neutral count badges; semantic typography. Implementations other than Button were not independently inspected.

components.name: StaleRefreshWarning
components.contract: Retained-data warning, polite status and existing retry; intentionally does not handle no-data initial failure.

components.name: FadeIn
components.contract: Existing motion preference; initial=false under reduction; bounded entrance delays; OS/low-bandwidth integration not exercised.

components.name: SectionFilter, SectionBand, FeatureCard, Highlight, EmptyResult
components.contract: Typed local helpers, one exported page; native links preserve modified-click semantics; escaped search highlighting; visibility-safe suggestions.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Eligibility predicates duplicate the shell's private isVisibleNavItem logic at Layout.tsx:526-532. Catalog itself correctly reuses navSections.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: If shell owner exposes a shared predicate, consume that exact existing policy; otherwise preserve both predicates and add parity coverage. Do not create a second registry.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Local navigation card owns border, background, radius, focus and hover chrome; suggestion buttons have another local border/background override at line 593. No second independently inspected production consumer proves a missing composite.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Reuse current tokens and shared primitives; keep feature-specific native-link semantics. Do not introduce a speculative shared FeatureCard from this one-page audit.

responsive.currentStrategy: Cards reflow 1/2/3/4/5 columns through sm/lg/2xl/3xl. Categories wrap rather than scroll; labels and paths break; card text stays visible. Brief stacks compact metrics at 1/sm2/md3/1920px6 columns. No intentional removal of sections on mobile.

issues.detail: Category buttons use size=sm with non-scrollable min-h-9 (36px), below the contract's stronger 44px mobile default. Clear and shared review/retry buttons also use sm. Actual target spacing and WCAG exception eligibility are unmeasured.
issues.fix: Verify target spacing at 320-430px and long labels; reuse an accepted shared size/density contract for 44px targets when required. Do not globally change Button sizing from the page.

responsive.verification: All ten mandated viewport widths, allocated-width behavior, 200% text, RTL and overflow are unverified.

sourceStrengths: Search has explicit identity, localized label, ref-based slash focus and decorative icon hiding.
Result bands have heading association; cards are native anchors in ul/li; modified clicks are not intercepted.
Category controls use pressed-filter semantics, not incorrect document tabs.
Result count is a status region; metric evidence is reachable through the existing drawer.
Search highlights escape regex input and do not inject HTML.

issues.rule: MDC-040 keyboard / MDC-024 overlay focus ownership
issues.detail: Document-level slash shortcut excludes input/textarea/contentEditable only; it does not check modifier keys, defaultPrevented, select targets or an active dialog. Source permits focus attempts behind the shared details drawer; actual trap behavior is unverified.
issues.fix: Preserve slash-to-search while respecting existing shortcut/overlay ownership, editable controls and handled/modifier events; test open drawer keyboard behavior before integration.

accessibility.verification: Keyboard traversal, drawer trapping/restoration, screen-reader announcements, effective contrast and forced-colors behavior have not been exercised.

states.loading: Fleet pending is explicit text/attention; local catalog remains usable. No global loading gate or fake vehicle zero metric. Auth pending is indistinguishable from open mode because page consumes only a boolean.
states.empty: Resolved [] means zero returned vehicles and conservative eligibility. No-match result has explanation, optional up-to-five suggestions, command-palette guidance and clear action; a section-only miss currently describes an empty query.
states.error: Fleet initial failure changes brief to Fleet unavailable, retains ungated catalog and hides vehicle-gated destinations. There is no initial-failure retry on this page.
states.staleOffline: Retained fleet remains eligible during refresh error/pause; StaleRefreshWarning supplies a retry when state.retry exists. No maxAgeMs supplied, so no page-specific age-expiry policy is established.
states.partialUnknown: Fleet missing raw metric is undefined with a missing reason; catalog counts remain local derived values. Auth error/offline/pending state is not surfaced. No server partial-list semantics are invented.

issues.detail: Only StaleRefreshWarning receives fleetState; that component returns null without retained data (StaleRefreshWarning.tsx:59). Initial failure attention explains missing fleet but provides no retry, although deriveDataState supplies retry at dataState.ts:200-219.
issues.fix: Add a source-scoped retry through existing OperationalBrief actions or existing feedback primitive when fatalError exists; preserve local catalog and independently usable search.

issues.detail: useIsForwardAuth hides auth-required entries for resolved open mode and unavailable/loading mode alike. sourceStatus describes fleet only, so Catalog ready can coexist with unresolved auth eligibility.
issues.fix: Retain conservative auth gating; consume existing useAuthMode trust separately to explain pending/unavailable authentication-mode source and offer source-scoped recovery without replacing the catalog.

issues.detail: A valid section with no searched matches or an unknown section URL can yield zero groups; empty title always attributes this to query and can show No features match "". Clear intentionally resets both filters.
issues.fix: Retain URL behavior and clear action; describe category-only and combined misses accurately using existing localization pipeline.

visualIssues.rule: MDC-010 / MDC-012 / mission sections 5-7 restrained theme-aware surfaces
visualIssues.detail: Icon tile uses bg-white/[0.04]; hover border at line 432 falls back to rgba(255,255,255,0.18). These are fixed-white surface/border remnants, not pure-white body text. Their effective light-theme contrast/intensity is unverified.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing semantic surface and border-hover tokens while retaining hover/focus affordance and neutral icon treatment.

visualIssues.rule: MDC-010 / MDC-011 / mission section 7 saturation budget
visualIssues.detail: Every matched token uses theme-primary/25 background. This is meaningful search emphasis, not evidence of a neon class; intensity depends on saved custom theme. Selected category also uses shared primary Button; no screenshot proves over-saturation.
visualIssues.fix: Review actual themes and dense multi-token results; if needed subdue through existing accepted semantic highlight/control tokens, preserving marks, selection cues and theme preferences.

architectureIssues.rule: MDC-002 category imports / MDC-030 shared navigation ownership
architectureIssues.detail: Feature data imports the concrete Layout module to obtain navSections. This is confirmed source coupling to shell implementation, not proof of a runtime chunk cycle.
architectureIssues.fix: Shared navigation owner may expose the same catalog and predicate through an existing appropriate public owner/barrel. Preserve item identities/order/gates; page writer must not edit shell or invent another catalog.

architectureIssues.detail: Feature descriptions render directly from the English DESCRIPTIONS map; fallback Open ${item.label} is also English. Suggestion engine uses registry/catalog fallback labels and renders s.label directly at line 596. Search already supports translated labels/sections, which must survive.
architectureIssues.fix: Add description identity and canonical localized resources through designated catalog ownership; render translated descriptions/suggestion names while preserving source paths, English search compatibility and ranking policy.

architectureIssues.rule: MDC-044 / mission section 26 centralized date formatting
architectureIssues.detail: Freshness is displayed with Date.toISOString rather than the existing locale/timezone display policy. Timestamp represents fleet query last load, not vehicle telemetry freshness, and is correctly described as such.
architectureIssues.fix: Use the established formatting hook at display boundary, retain timestamp and query-load meaning, and keep unknown load time distinct.

priority.reason: Discovery already uses shared layout/brief/filter/state mechanisms and restrained card styling. Prioritize initial source recovery, honest auth eligibility, localization and shortcut safety over further cosmetic redesign.
sequence: Coordinate canonical catalog localization/shared navigation owner
Replace fixed-white remnants with existing tokens

requiredSharedChanges.name: Canonical catalog localization
requiredSharedChanges.propsVariantsStates: Stable descriptionKey and fallback per existing destination; canonical locale resources owned by designated catalog writer; translated description/suggestion label in ready and empty states; no new production catalog.

requiredSharedChanges.name: Existing navigation ownership cleanup
requiredSharedChanges.propsVariantsStates: Expose existing navSections and identical eligibility predicate accepting entry, returned vehicle count and resolved forward-auth boolean; preserve unknown-source conservative false behavior, source order and all item metadata. Do not create a replacement registry.

confirmed: Explore duplicates shell eligibility predicates; feature descriptions enrich rather than replace navSections.
notEstablished: No competing query store, date picker, unit-conversion engine, theme provider or chart implementation found in inspected page.
Local Highlight/FeatureCard do not justify a new global composite without independent-consumer evidence.

sectionCounts.dynamicResultBands: One per filtered eligible catalog group; zero for no-match alternative.

actions.name: Select category or All with pressed state and counts
Slash focuses search without taking over editable text
Normal card click uses navigate; modified/middle click retains native destination
Pick eligible nearest-route suggestion, clear URL search and navigate
Clear no-match filter resets all URL search parameters
Review details opens existing evidence/metrics/attention drawer; close stays shared
Retained-source refresh when shared warning exposes retry

dataBehavior: Preserve all existing destinations, descriptions, labels/keys, section order, gates and native link destinations.
Features/categories count the eligible catalog before filtering; Showing counts search/category intersection; Vehicles is returned list length with unknown distinct from zero.
Preserve exact-section matching, case-insensitive AND tokens, translated and English label/section search, path and description matching.
Keep retained fleet eligibility during refresh failure/offline; keep conservative eligibility without a fleet/auth-mode result.
No date/workspace vehicle selector applies to this local catalog; do not add duplicate controls.
Preserve q/section parameter identities, replace-history policy, other-parameter retention on individual updates and all-parameter clearing on existing clear/suggestion actions.
Preserve safe escaped marks and registry/catalog merge, path de-duplication, gate intersection and five-suggestion cap.
Preserve query keys, AbortSignal, safeArray, inherited policies, raw counts, existing display preferences, document title and test IDs.
No exports, mutations, charts or vehicle telemetry sources exist in this inspected page; no new ones are proposed.

evidenceLimits.scope: Single assigned page and bounded page-specific imports/source contracts. Only report and heartbeat written.
evidenceLimits.mode: Source-only Phase 0 audit; no browser, server, network requests, screenshots or rendered fixtures.
evidenceLimits.visual: UNVERIFIED; fixed-white remnants and accent risk are source findings, not measured contrast or screenshot conclusions.
evidenceLimits.keyboard: UNVERIFIED; semantics and shortcut conditions inspected only.
evidenceLimits.backend: Only exact relevant router registrations inspected by bounded search; no handler/repository/authentication/response/permission/pagination behavior inferred.
evidenceLimits.dependencies: Shared public contracts were selectively read; Input/GlassPanel/Badge/Typography/Drawer implementations, formatting-hook internals and complete App/shell/client were not audited.
evidenceLimits.tests: Existing Explore/catalog test source read for preservation context; not executed and not runtime proof. No TypeScript, lint, build or full-repository tests run.
evidenceLimits.skillLimit: Scoped audit.sh inspected but not executed: it unconditionally runs project TypeScript. Assignment/design contract reserve heavy validation for orchestrator. Bounded read-only source pattern counts used instead.
evidenceLimits.countMethod: PowerShell regex scan of assigned page raw text; includes comments if matching and is not a semantic/global violations certification. Separate bounded Layout declaration scan lines 183-522 supplies static catalog counts.
evidenceLimits.sourceStability: Page SHA-256 checked at audit and final validation; adjacent shared source can change concurrently. No Git operations.
